The main takeaway from our work is that
label propagation is a very useful and powerful tool in the video analysis domain, and that it can significantly reduce the amount of manual labelling needed for video analysis.
the proposed label propagation scheme can produce high quality pixelwise labels from a small number of seed pixels and can be used to produce ground truth data in a semi-automatic manner.
